name: oneprovider-maestro
description: One extension to run OneProvider models everywhere: native Copilot Chat provider, Claude Code launcher/config manager, Codex CLI/IDE provider setup, and a live balance & usage dashboard with per-session cost tracking.

commands.title: OneProvider Maestro: Sync Models from API
OneProvider Maestro: Reset Session Spend Counter
OneProvider Maestro: Use Model in Claude Code
OneProvider Maestro: Restore Claude Code Defaults (Anthropic)
OneProvider Maestro: Use Model in Codex

oneproviderMaestro.apiEndpoint.description: OneProvider OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Change this only if you use a proxy.

oneproviderMaestro.anthropicBaseUrl.description: OneProvider Anthropic-native base URL written into Claude Code's ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. Claude Code appends /v1/messages itself, so there is no /v1 suffix here.

oneproviderMaestro.cache.ttlMinutes.description: How many minutes before the model list is considered stale and automatically refreshed.

oneproviderMaestro.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from OneProvider before timing out.

oneproviderMaestro.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests (rate limits, server errors).

oneproviderMaestro.defaultTemperature.description: Default temperature for model responses (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = creative). Leave empty to use the model default.

oneproviderMaestro.defaultMaxTokens.description: Default maximum output tokens. Leave empty to use the model default.

oneproviderMaestro.showCatalogOnlyModels.description: Also list models from the bundled OneProvider catalog that the live /v1/models endpoint did not return for your key. They are marked "catalog only" and may not be usable.

oneproviderMaestro.maxInputTokensOverrid.description: Override the maxInputTokens reported to VS Code. Lower values trigger conversation compaction earlier, preventing oversized request bodies. Leave empty to auto-calculate from the model's context window.

oneproviderMaestro.reasoningEffortModelP.description: Regular expression matching model ids that accept OpenAI-style `reasoning_effort`. OneProvider exposes Claude thinking as separate `-thinking` model ids instead, so those need no parameter. Widen this only if you know your models accept the field; an unsupported field is rejected with 400.

oneproviderMaestro.defaultReasoningEffor.description: Default thinking effort for models matched by reasoningEffortModelPattern. "none" omits the field entirely. The Copilot model-picker Thinking Effort submenu overrides this per session.

oneproviderMaestro.usage.enabled.description: Fetch live balance and usage from the OneProvider dashboard API. Disabling this stops the extension from sending your API key to dashboard.oneprovider.dev; the Usage tab then only shows locally tracked session spend.

oneproviderMaestro.usage.endpoint.description: OneProvider dashboard lookup endpoint used for balance and usage figures.

oneproviderMaestro.usage.autoRefreshMinu.description: How often to refresh balance and usage in the background. Set to 0 to refresh only on demand.

oneproviderMaestro.usage.defaultRangeDay.description: Time range the Usage tab opens with.

oneproviderMaestro.statusBar.mode.description: What the status bar item shows.
enumDescriptions: Cost burned in this VS Code session

oneproviderMaestro.claudeCode.settingsSc.description: Where to write Claude Code environment settings: 'user' (~/.claude/settings.json, applies everywhere) or 'project' (.claude/settings.local.json in the current workspace only).

oneproviderMaestro.claudeCode.smallFastM.description: OneProvider model id to use for Claude Code background/haiku-class tasks (ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL). Leave empty to use the same model as the main one.

oneproviderMaestro.codex.configPath.description: Path to the Codex config.toml. Leave empty for the default ~/.codex/config.toml.

oneproviderMaestro.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the OneProvider Maestro output channel.
enumDescriptions: Show all messages including debug details

scripts.test: npx --yes tsx --test src/__tests__/apiKeyUtils.test.ts src/__tests__/modelId.test.ts src/__tests__/reasoningEffort.test.ts src/__tests__/modelCatalog.test.ts src/__tests__/sessionUsage.test.ts
